text: The iPhone in your pocket, made part of your Mac.
Every gesture you know, with a click you can feel.
Its buttons follow the app in front, in more than seventy apps.
Pin the Mac controls you reach for every day.
Everything else is one touch away.
Or put two or three side by side.
From the couch, it's a remote.
On stage, it keeps time and points for you.
Send any window to another display.
At night, it's a clock on your nightstand.
Twenty-eight themes, to make it yours.
Pair once with a scan. It stays between your iPhone and your Mac.
